title: Fluor Enters into Long-Term Agreement with Aramco
summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has been selected by Saudi-based Aramco as a Program Management Consultancy (PMC) contractor under a Long-Term Agreement (LTA) to support its global capital projects portfolio. The LTA will allow efficient deployment of Fluor’s global expertise, local workforce and digital project delivery capabilities.
